recommendation: Bare BosonField is not a clean identity: an existing same-category GitHub AI creative project is the strongest conflict, and several exact social handles are occupied. First verify whether the GitHub project is controlled by Ryan; if not, prefer a differentiated identity such as BosonFieldAI or BosonFieldOpen and reserve the same variant consistently across platforms. The strongest domain candidates from the RDAP checks are bosonfield.ai, bosonfield.video, bosonfield.dev, and bosonfield.tools, subject to registrar checkout confirmation. If retaining the bare name, obtain permission or assess the risk of coexistence with the existing project before launch.
legal_caveat: Formal legal clearance is not the same as web search. RDAP 404s, social-profile checks, and preliminary registry queries do not prove trademark or domain availability. A qualified trademark professional should search exact, phonetic, design, common-law, and related marks across the US, EU, UK, and relevant Nice classes. The EUIPO and UK IPO live checks were technically inconclusive here, so they require manual follow-up.
